name: Gl1_L6Geom
description:
Render L6Geom geometry.

.. ystaticattr:: Gl1_L6Geom.phiScale(=1.)

	Scale local rotations (phi<L6Geom.phi> - phi0<L6Geom.phi0>). The default scale is to draw $\pi$ rotation with length equal to minimum radius.
